basis: upstream branch HEAD resolved to immutable commit at retrieval time; this is an audit snapshot, not a claim about the historical extraction revision
comparisonMethod: Resolve ANSI, terminal and syntax references through the local palette, then compare each hex against pinned raw source files. This establishes value presence; semantic role intent is documented in theme specs.

solarized-osaka.comparisonNote: Upstream stores palette colors as HSL and the project resolves them through its hslToHex implementation; local hex literal occurrence is not a valid equality check.

tokyodark.comparisonNote: Resolved palette values are defined in lua/tokyodark/palette.lua; syntax assignments are in highlights.lua.
